texts.preamble: Kamal Kishore Gupta And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 6 December, 2022 Author: Gautam Chowdhary Bench: Gautam Chowdhary High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad ?Court No. - 87 Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 39481 of 2022 Applicant :- Kamal Kishore Gupta And 2 Others Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others Counsel for Applicant :- Rohan Gupta Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
texts.facts: This application has been filed for quashing of the proceedings of Complaint Case No. 39149 of 2022 under Section 26 read with Section 51, 59 of Food Safety Standards Act, 2006 pending before learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Moradabad as well as to quash the summoning order dated 29.06.2022 passed in the aforesaid case.
texts.arguments: At this stage, the learned counsel for the applicants submits that the applicants have so far not been arrested in the above case and the police is seeking to arrest the applicants and there may be coercive processes issued against the applicants by the court concerned therefore, some direction may be issued to the court concerned for consideration of the bail prayer of the applicants. As the Apex Court in Satendra Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another (Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No. 5191 of 2021, decided on 07.10.2021) has already laid down guidelines for grant of bail, without fettering the discretion of the courts concerned and the statutory provisions governing consideration in grant of bail, no specific direction need be issued by this Court as it is expected that the court concerned will take into consideration the necessary guidelines already issued by the Apex court.
texts.petitioner_arguments: At this stage, the learned counsel for the applicants submits that the applicants have so far not been arrested in the above case and the police is seeking to arrest the applicants and there may be coercive processes issued against the applicants by the court concerned therefore, some direction may be issued to the court concerned for consideration of the bail prayer of the applicants.
